hexagrams.name: The Creative
hexagrams.judgment: Sustained creative force, originating and firm; the dragon ascends through heaven. Persistent strength brings sublime success.
hexagrams.image: Heaven over heaven: the superior force, tireless and self-renewing, sets all things in motion.

hexagrams.name: The Receptive
hexagrams.judgment: Yielding earth, devoted and nourishing; the mare follows the level ground. Receptive devotion brings success.
hexagrams.image: Earth over earth: the receptive bears and sustains, supporting all creatures without striving.

hexagrams.name: Difficulty at the Beginning
hexagrams.judgment: Sprouting through hard soil amid thunder and rain; tangled beginnings demand helpers and order from chaos.
hexagrams.image: Water over thunder: clouds and movement, the struggle of birth before things untangle.

hexagrams.name: Youthful Folly
hexagrams.judgment: The young fool seeks the teacher; patience and honest questioning turn inexperience into understanding.
hexagrams.image: Mountain over water: a spring at the foot of the mountain, undirected, needing guidance to find its course.

hexagrams.name: Waiting
hexagrams.judgment: Clouds rise to heaven yet hold their rain; nourishing patience and inner confidence carry one across the great water.
hexagrams.image: Water over heaven: the strong wait, eating and drinking in calm certainty until the moment ripens.

hexagrams.name: Conflict
hexagrams.judgment: Sincerity obstructed breeds dispute; caution and a fair arbiter avert ruinous strife. Do not press the quarrel to its end.
hexagrams.image: Heaven over water: forces pulling apart, opposed in their natures, breeding contention.

hexagrams.name: The Army
hexagrams.judgment: Discipline and a seasoned leader give the multitude direction; the host moves as one under just command.
hexagrams.image: Earth over water: the hidden depths beneath the field, the gathered multitude awaiting order.

hexagrams.name: Holding Together
hexagrams.judgment: Waters flow into union; loyalty and timely alliance bind the many. Those who come late find the gate closed.
hexagrams.image: Water over earth: streams joining upon the land, drawing the scattered into solidarity.

hexagrams.name: The Taming Power of the Small
hexagrams.judgment: Gentle restraint of a great force; dense clouds gather without rain. Small means accumulate toward influence.
hexagrams.image: Wind over heaven: the gentle wind holds back the strong, restraining by patience rather than power.

hexagrams.name: Treading
hexagrams.judgment: Treading on the tiger's tail with courtesy and care; conduct that is alert and respectful escapes harm.
hexagrams.image: Heaven over lake: the high and the joyous distinguished, careful conduct keeping rank and measure.

hexagrams.name: Peace
hexagrams.judgment: Heaven and earth unite; the small departs and the great approaches. Harmony flowers as forces interpenetrate.
hexagrams.image: Earth over heaven: the receptive above, the creative below, their meeting bringing flourishing peace.

hexagrams.name: Standstill
hexagrams.judgment: Heaven and earth draw apart; communication fails and the petty rise. Withdraw and hold your integrity through stagnation.
hexagrams.image: Heaven over earth: forces separating, no exchange, the season of obstruction and decline.

hexagrams.name: Fellowship with Men
hexagrams.judgment: Open kinship in the bright field; fellowship freely shared crosses the great water and unites diverse people.
hexagrams.image: Heaven over fire: flame rising toward heaven, the clarity that gathers people in common cause.

hexagrams.name: Possession in Great Measure
hexagrams.judgment: Fire blazes high in heaven; clarity joined to strength brings abundance held with humility. Supreme success.
hexagrams.image: Fire over heaven: the sun at midheaven, great possession illuminating all, curbing evil and fostering good.

hexagrams.name: Modesty
hexagrams.judgment: The mountain hidden within the earth; modesty carried through to the end brings honor and lasting success.
hexagrams.image: Earth over mountain: the high made low, greatness that diminishes itself and so endures.

hexagrams.name: Enthusiasm
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder bursts from the earth; rousing enthusiasm marshals helpers and sets armies moving with inspired devotion.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over earth: stirring movement breaking forth, music and momentum awakening the many.

hexagrams.name: Following
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder sleeps within the lake; adapting to the time and following what is right brings supreme success without blame.
hexagrams.image: Lake over thunder: movement met with joy, leading by yielding, the wise drawing others to follow.

hexagrams.name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
hexagrams.judgment: Decay from neglect calls for repair; resolute remedy of corruption restores what was ruined. Cross the great water.
hexagrams.image: Mountain over wind: the wind stilled beneath the mountain, stagnation that must be cleared by diligent work.

hexagrams.name: Approach
hexagrams.judgment: The strong approaches and grows; joyful advance brings success, yet the eighth month warns of decline. Act in season.
hexagrams.image: Earth over lake: the land above the joyous water, the great drawing near to nurture and oversee.

hexagrams.name: Contemplation
hexagrams.judgment: The wind moves over the earth; the watcher contemplates from above, surveying with reverence to guide the people.
hexagrams.image: Wind over earth: the gentle sweeping across the land, observation that teaches by example.

hexagrams.name: Biting Through
hexagrams.judgment: An obstruction in the teeth; decisive biting through, just punishment and clear law remove the obstacle. Success.
hexagrams.image: Fire over thunder: lightning and thunder united, clarity and movement enforcing order.

hexagrams.name: Grace
hexagrams.judgment: Fire lights the foot of the mountain; grace and adornment bring small success when form serves substance.
hexagrams.image: Mountain over fire: tranquil brightness, beauty and culture illuminating without overreaching.

hexagrams.name: Splitting Apart
hexagrams.judgment: The mountain crumbles to the earth; the dark undermines the firm. It does not further to go anywhere now; wait.
hexagrams.image: Mountain over earth: the upper line alone above decay, collapse spreading from below.

hexagrams.name: Return
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder stirs within the earth; the light returns at the solstice of the year. The turning point comes of itself.
hexagrams.image: Earth over thunder: the first yang reborn below, renewal quietly beginning, friends arriving without blame.

hexagrams.name: Innocence
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder rolls under heaven; spontaneous innocence accords with the time. The unexpected brings no blame to the upright.
hexagrams.image: Heaven over thunder: movement led by the creative, the natural and unpremeditated, true to instinct.

hexagrams.name: The Taming Power of the Great
hexagrams.judgment: Heaven held within the mountain; great restraint stores up strength and virtue. Cross the great water; feed the worthy.
hexagrams.image: Mountain over heaven: vast power kept still and accumulated, daily renewed for great use.

hexagrams.name: Nourishment
hexagrams.judgment: The open mouth at rest; watch what nourishes you and what you give. Right nourishment of body and mind brings fortune.
hexagrams.image: Mountain over thunder: stillness above, movement below, the jaws taking in sustenance with care.

hexagrams.name: Preponderance of the Great
hexagrams.judgment: The ridgepole sags under excessive weight; the great overloads the weak ends. Move with purpose, find a way through.
hexagrams.image: Lake over wind: the lake rising over the trees, an extraordinary, overburdened time demanding decisive passage.

hexagrams.name: The Abysmal
hexagrams.judgment: Water plunges into the chasm and flows on; repeated danger met with sincerity and steadfast heart wins through.
hexagrams.image: Water over water: the abyss doubled, the flowing depth that fills each pit and continues without losing its nature.

hexagrams.name: The Clinging
hexagrams.judgment: Fire clings to its fuel; clarity dependent on what sustains it. Care for the source brings brightness and success.
hexagrams.image: Fire over fire: light doubled, the sun and clarity clinging, illumining the four quarters.

hexagrams.name: Influence
hexagrams.judgment: The lake rests on the mountain; mutual attraction and gentle influence woo a response. Courtship brings union.
hexagrams.image: Lake over mountain: the joyous above the still, stimulation that draws hearts toward each other.

hexagrams.name: Duration
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder and wind endure together; constancy in the right course gives lasting success. Have a goal and persevere.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over wind: enduring movement and penetration paired, the steady continuity of what lasts.

hexagrams.name: Retreat
hexagrams.judgment: The mountain rises but heaven withdraws; timely retreat preserves strength against the encroaching dark. Small success.
hexagrams.image: Heaven over mountain: the creative drawing back as shadow climbs, dignified withdrawal at the right moment.

hexagrams.name: The Power of the Great
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder peals in heaven; great power surges, but force without rightness is ruin. Hold to what is correct.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over heaven: vigorous movement above the strong, abundant power needing measure and law.

hexagrams.name: Progress
hexagrams.judgment: The sun rises over the earth; steady advance and recognition reward the devoted servant. Brilliant progress.
hexagrams.image: Fire over earth: light emerging above the land, dawn of clarity spreading and ascending.

hexagrams.name: Darkening of the Light
hexagrams.judgment: The sun sinks beneath the earth; in adversity veil your brightness, keep inner light, and persevere through hardship.
hexagrams.image: Earth over fire: clarity wounded and hidden, the wise tempering brilliance amid a darkened time.

hexagrams.name: The Family
hexagrams.judgment: Wind issues from fire; each member keeps their place, and the well-ordered household radiates order outward.
hexagrams.image: Wind over fire: warmth generating influence, the inner order of the family shaping the world.

hexagrams.name: Opposition
hexagrams.judgment: Fire rises, the lake sinks; estrangement and misunderstanding. In small matters, reconcile difference for fortune.
hexagrams.image: Fire over lake: two natures turning away, opposition that yet allows union in particulars.

hexagrams.name: Obstruction
hexagrams.judgment: Water atop the mountain bars the path; in the face of obstruction turn within, seek the wise, and wait to act.
hexagrams.image: Water over mountain: danger before the steep ascent, the obstacle that bids one pause and gather allies.

hexagrams.name: Deliverance
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder and rain break the tension; the storm clears and bonds loosen. Return to order; pardon and release.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over water: movement freeing itself from danger, the dissolving of what was held fast.

hexagrams.name: Decrease
hexagrams.judgment: The lake deepens as the mountain is lowered; sincere decrease of the lower enriches the higher. Simplicity brings fortune.
hexagrams.image: Mountain over lake: diminishing below to add above, restraint of anger and desire.

hexagrams.name: Increase
hexagrams.judgment: Wind and thunder strengthen each other; the high sacrifices to the low and all increase. Cross the great water.
hexagrams.image: Wind over thunder: mutual stimulation multiplying force, the generous time of growth and benefit.

hexagrams.name: Breakthrough
hexagrams.judgment: The lake rises to heaven and bursts; resolute breakthrough denounces the wrong, but force alone is perilous.
hexagrams.image: Lake over heaven: pent water about to break, decisive resolution dissolving the last obstruction.

hexagrams.name: Coming to Meet
hexagrams.judgment: The wind moves under heaven; a single dark line returns, alluring but not to be embraced. Beware unbidden meeting.
hexagrams.image: Heaven over wind: the creative meeting the insinuating, a powerful encounter that must be watched.

hexagrams.name: Gathering Together
hexagrams.judgment: The lake gathers on the earth; people assemble around a center. The leader and offering unite the host. Success.
hexagrams.image: Lake over earth: waters collecting into a pool, congregation drawn to a worthy focal point.

hexagrams.name: Pushing Upward
hexagrams.judgment: Wood grows upward through the earth; effortful ascent step by step brings supreme success. Seek the great.
hexagrams.image: Earth over wind: the seedling rising within the soil, gradual and devoted upward growth.

hexagrams.name: Oppression
hexagrams.judgment: The lake drained dry, exhausted; in confinement keep faith and few words. Adversity tests the great and they prevail.
hexagrams.image: Lake over water: the water sunk away, depletion and constraint endured with inner cheer.

hexagrams.name: The Well
hexagrams.judgment: Water drawn up through wood; the well nourishes all and does not move. Tend the source; let the rope reach the water.
hexagrams.image: Water over wind: the deep raised to the surface, the inexhaustible common spring of the people.

hexagrams.name: Revolution
hexagrams.judgment: Fire within the lake transforms; when the time is ripe, molting and revolution renew the order. Sincerity removes regret.
hexagrams.image: Lake over fire: opposed forces forcing change, the radical turning of the seasons.

hexagrams.name: The Cauldron
hexagrams.judgment: Wood feeds fire beneath the vessel; the cauldron cooks nourishment and consecrates the worthy. Supreme good fortune.
hexagrams.image: Fire over wind: flame fed by wood, transformation refining the raw into the sacred.

hexagrams.name: The Arousing
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder repeats and shakes; sudden shock brings terror, then laughter. The composed keep the sacred vessel and do not falter.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over thunder: the rousing doubled, the startling movement that awakens fear and renewal.

hexagrams.name: Keeping Still
hexagrams.judgment: The mountain doubled, immovable; stilling the back quiets the restless heart. Stillness in season brings no blame.
hexagrams.image: Mountain over mountain: rest upon rest, the meditative quiet that knows when to stop.

hexagrams.name: Development
hexagrams.judgment: The tree grows slowly on the mountain; gradual, orderly development like a maiden's marriage brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image: Wind over mountain: wood maturing on the heights, patient step-by-step advance that lasts.

hexagrams.name: The Marrying Maiden
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder stirs the lake; entering a bond in a subordinate place. Undertakings bring misfortune; understand the limits.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over lake: movement rousing joy, a relationship of unequal standing demanding tact.

hexagrams.name: Abundance
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder and lightning together at the zenith; abundance and fullness flare at noon. Be like the sun, undismayed by decline.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over fire: clarity and movement joined, the height of plenty that must be used while it shines.

hexagrams.name: The Wanderer
hexagrams.judgment: Fire roams over the mountain, not resting; the stranger travels light, cautious and reserved. Small success on the road.
hexagrams.image: Fire over mountain: flame moving on, the transient guest who keeps measure in foreign lands.

hexagrams.name: The Gentle
hexagrams.judgment: Wind follows upon wind, penetrating softly; gentle, persistent influence accomplishes its aim. Have a goal; see the great.
hexagrams.image: Wind over wind: the penetrating doubled, the mild force that works ceaselessly into every corner.

hexagrams.name: The Joyous
hexagrams.judgment: Lake rests upon lake; shared joy and open exchange bring success. True gladness perseveres and gathers friends.
hexagrams.image: Lake over lake: waters joined and glad, the joy of encouragement and frank discussion.

hexagrams.name: Dispersion
hexagrams.judgment: Wind drives over the water and scatters it; dissolving rigidity and self-interest reunites what was frozen. Cross the great water.
hexagrams.image: Wind over water: the gentle dispersing the deep, melting hardness into flowing union.

hexagrams.name: Limitation
hexagrams.judgment: Water held within the lake has its measure; wholesome limitation brings success, but galling limits should not persist.
hexagrams.image: Water over lake: the vessel that bounds the water, the articulating limits that make order possible.

hexagrams.name: Inner Truth
hexagrams.judgment: Wind stirs the surface of the lake; inner truth and sincerity reach even pigs and fishes. Confidence crosses the great water.
hexagrams.image: Wind over lake: the gentle moving upon the open, conviction that penetrates from the heart outward.

hexagrams.name: Preponderance of the Small
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder on the mountain, a small excess; in small things one may exceed, in great things not. The bird should descend.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over mountain: movement above stillness, attention to the modest and the careful detail.

hexagrams.name: After Completion
hexagrams.judgment: Water over fire in balance; the work is finished, yet order at its peak begins to slip. Guard against disorder to the end.
hexagrams.image: Water over fire: equilibrium achieved, every line in place, the fragile completeness that must be maintained.

hexagrams.name: Before Completion
hexagrams.judgment: Fire over water, not yet ordered; transition nears its goal. Like the fox crossing the ice, caution at the last brings success.
hexagrams.image: Fire over water: forces not yet aligned, the threshold before completion demanding care and timing.
